purpose: Define input modules and adapters as bounded translation/mount boundaries: inputs validate and write owned inert data, while adapters mount symbols without creating private execution authority.

topics.name: Inputs and Adapters
topics.purpose: Define input modules and adapters as bounded translation/mount boundaries: inputs validate and write owned inert data, while adapters mount symbols without creating private execution authority.

operations.name: Write validated input to owned symbol surface

semantics.input_rule: Input modules receive external/local data, validate it, and write only their owned symbol surface.
semantics.adapter_rule: Adapter is a symbol mount/translation boundary, not an independent command or authority owner.
semantics.data_rule: Input payload remains inert until explicit Trigger/operation/dispatcher semantics act on it.
semantics.schema_rule: Boundary data uses explicit schema and unknown-field policy.
semantics.ownership_rule: Input/adapters cannot write arbitrary unrelated symbol roots.
semantics.effect_rule: Receiving data is not itself permission to perform external effects.

invariants.rule: Runtime capabilities, dispatch and mutable state remain explicit, bounded and Core-governed.

hard_gates.condition: input writes unrelated symbol root outside owned target
unknown fields silently accepted without schema rule

references.purpose: Boundary payloads validate against explicit schema.
Inputs write owned registered symbol surfaces.
